newsitem.title: SPAIN: Council of Europe issue 10 bln pta at 101 - leads.
newsitem.headline: Council of Europe issue 10 bln pta at 101 - leads.

text.p: The Council of Europe is issuing at a price of 101 a 10 billion peseta bond maturing on November 2007, joint lead manager and joint book runner said, Banco de Negocio Argentaria and BNP Espana y Mutuactivos.
The bond is giving a coupon of 7.14 percent in the first four years. From the fifth year, it will pay a coupon of 8.40 percent until the maturity.
BORROWER COUNCIL OF EUROPE SOCIAL DVL FUND
TYPE STRAIGHT ISS PRICE 101 PAY DATE 15.11.1996
LEAD MGR AND BOOK RUNNER ARGENTARIA AND BNP
NOTES * FROM THE FIFTH YEAR TO MATURITY AT 8.40%
